sections.title: Headline
sections.content: AI agents and agent-oriented developer workflows dominate today's GitHub momentum, while a real-time geospatial visualization project is the day's strongest non-agent breakout. The list also shows growing interest in local-first tools, persistent knowledge bases, and autonomous market/research systems.

sections.title: ayghri/i-have-adhd
sections.description: A skill to stop your coding agent from burying the answer. ADHD-friendly output.

sections.title: bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view
sections.description: A spy satellite simulator in your browser, except the data is real. Live open source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe.

sections.title: obra/superpowers
sections.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.

sections.title: nashsu/llm_wiki
sections.description: A cross-platform desktop application that turns documents into an organized, interlinked knowledge base.

sections.title: alsk1992/CloddsBot
sections.description: Open Source AI trading agent operating across markets.

sections.title: vastsa/PI-Desktop
sections.description: Local-first AI coding agent desktop with Electron, Rust host core, and plugins.

sections.title: p1neappleXpress/OpenFlux
sections.description: Network stack research tool. TCP tunnel with pluggable transports.

sections.title: Sonarr/Sonarr
sections.description: Smart PVR for newsgroup and bittorrent users.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Agentic developer workflows, persistent AI knowledge systems, domain-specific autonomy, local-first tooling, and geospatial visualization are the main signals. TypeScript leads the listed top 10 with three repositories; Python has two; JavaScript, Shell, C, Go, and C# each have one.

sections.title: Notable Shifts
sections.content: Momentum is broadening from model wrappers toward agent operating practices and durable agent infrastructure: skills, plugins, desktop hosts, research wikis, and domain-specific autonomous systems.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: The strongest pattern is the productization of agents: better workflows, local execution, persistent memory, and domain-specific autonomy. Developers are building systems that act over time and integrate with real work, research, markets, and creative tools.
